Pre-release build for ${TAG}. Binaries are not code-signed. Check files against SHA256SUMS.txt. Install steps are in [docs/install.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/blob/${TAG}/docs/install.md).

## Changes

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/blob/${TAG}/CHANGELOG.md).

## Requirements

- Linux binaries are built on Ubuntu 22.04. The client needs glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+). The host is released from [PandaQuQ/robroz](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz).

## Known issues

- None listed.
